title: Chapter 418
paragraphs: Chapter 418
Episode 121. Betrayal (1)
What on earth is happening...?
Everyone couldn't help but think that.

Who would have predicted that the essence of the supreme martial arts of Vermont, which seemed like it would never break unless a world war broke out, would be shattered so mercilessly and without warning?
The ones who had destroyed Sword Emperor's Castle had already left using their unknown power.
Even though the knights had joined the battle by the time it ended, it didn't seem like the terrorists had suffered any fatal injuries and retreated.
It was a complete defeat.
Black smoke carelessly rose from various parts of the almost ruined Sword Emperor's Castle.
"Brother Jin."
Murakan and Linpa approached Jin. Murakan's face was exhausted from the battle, while Linpa looked as calm as when she was first summoned.
Murakan had desperately blocked the bombardment and the leader's attacks with Ron, but Linpa hadn't had a chance to show her full power.
As Jin's body swayed forward, Linpa supported him.

Just like when he summoned Garmund in the past, Jin felt sorry for Linpa this time as well. It was a feeling of guilt that stemmed from the fact that she, who had returned to Lafrarosa, would not remember anything.
Linpa nodded her head as if to say she understood without being told.
"The outside world... has changed a lot. A toy... it's the first time I've seen something so huge."
"Only you brothers could describe Velekte Sidricar as a toy in this world."
"I... will go back. There's a lot to do."
"Thank you, Brother Linpa."
Linpa smiled as she ruffled Jin's hair.
Then, she soon wore a heavy expression and said this.
"That demon... his face is familiar."
"Are you talking about Kinzelo's leader?"
Linpa nodded her head.
"I'm sure... we've encountered him before. With us... brothers."
At that remark, Jin raised an eyebrow and met Linpa's eyes.
"What do you mean? Are you saying that you've fought with the Demon King's family before?"
"I'm not sure about that... but... I'm certain. We've met before..."
Linpa tried to recall more about the leader, but she only seemed to be sure of the feeling that they had met before. She couldn't remember anything else.

-Kinzelo's leader, are you saying that I've encountered him a thousand years ago as well...? I thought he was just a demon with something picked up from somewhere. It seems he's a demon with some connection to me.
Suddenly, he remembered the moment when he had a conversation with Murakan about the leader after leaving Temar's second tomb.
In the records guarded by the guardian Sarah, Murakan and the other Ten Knights found the Tower of the Black Sea, and they saw Temar and Kinzelo's leader just after that moment.
'Back then, I thought Murakan just couldn't remember the leader due to a problem with his memory... Maybe.'
The records about the leader could have been manipulated.
Such a thought occurred to him.
In the records, Murakan seemed to be quite familiar with the leader from a thousand years ago, and Linpa was sure that she "knew him but couldn't remember" as soon as she saw him.
'If the history and records about the leader were manipulated, it would naturally be done by Zipfel. But why?'
He couldn't know the exact reason immediately. However, it was a problem that could be thought of too simply.
'Because he's a threat.'
The power and authority shown by the leader must have been threatening even to Zipfel from a thousand years ago.
Despite looking so unstable, he pressured the entire Sword Emperor's Castle alone, blocked Ron and Murakan, and continuously recovered his allies' strength in real-time, which everyone saw clearly.
Everyone had a feeling.
If Kinzelo's leader had been in a 'perfect' state, the battle wouldn't have ended at this point.
"Be careful... Brother Jin. He's dangerous."
"I understand."
"See you... next time."
Whoooosh...
Linpa's body was slowly becoming blurry as it turned into particles of spirit. Jin looked at Linpa's disappearing figure and sighed bitterly.
He surveyed the situation.
The swords of Hairan, including the Dragon Knights, checked on those who were buried under the rubble or injured, and the forces that had fought together were recovering their troops.
Veradin was still being carried by Enya, and Shuri, who had approached them without realizing it, informed them that Dante had been safely transported away.
'At least, we've avoided the worst situation since they're safe.'
During the height of the chaos, Jin was the first to move to save those two. What remained now was to clean up and counterattack, which was not Jin's responsibility.
"My lord!"
The Dragon Knight commander landed beside Ron.
Ron was looking around, spitting dark red blood between his lips. Suddenly, it felt like even that was an unrealistic sight.
Hoo, hoo...

It seemed as if Ron's rough breathing could be heard even from a considerable distance. Despite his disheveled hair and numerous large and small wounds all over his body, a strange dignity was still felt from him.
Ron strode towards Jin.

At that moment, all the warriors who were watching held their breath and blinked their eyes. It was because, right after the battle ended, Ron looked for the riders of Runcandel rather than the nobles of Hairan.
The eyes of the crowd followed the two of them. Soon, Ron approached Jin, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and suddenly grabbed Jin's right arm.
Snap!
Then, Ron raised Jin's right arm high into the sky, as if paying tribute to the winner of a competition.
It was a shocking scene for the crowd, following the terror they had just experienced. Some people unknowingly covered their mouths with both hands and swallowed hard.
The lord of Hairan, the Sword Emperor, paying tribute to the 12th rider of Runcandel after the terror was an unreal situation.
Jin felt nervous inside… No, actually, he was just as surprised as those who covered their mouths with both hands. But he tried to maintain a poker face.
Of course, Jin quickly realized why Ron had chosen to praise him first.
‘It’s to block Runcandel.’
The Sword Emperor's castle had been destroyed in the terror, and Ron Hairan had been seriously injured.
The best time for one beast to attack another is when the opponent is injured. In other words, external forces trying to restrain Hairan would get the best opportunity after today.
Runcandel was undoubtedly the most awkward force among them. If Runcandel understood the situation and attacked Hairan intentionally, Hairan would not have the strength to resist.
The only forces they could rely on were the Royal Court and Zipfel, but the former was already cautious of Hairan, and the latter was even more dangerous than the Royal Court.
What if Jin, who attended the banquet as a representative of Runcandel, was taken care of first?
Even Runcandel, known for their unruliness, couldn't attack Hairan after such a warm atmosphere was created (especially with all the participating forces watching).
‘Well, even if Lord Ron didn't do this, the chances of Runcandel attacking Hairan are low… but there's no more efficient and safe move for Hairan to make.’
It was chilling in some ways. The fact that he made such a sharp judgment right after the chaotic situation ended. And he was the world's best knight, in an ideal position to be arrogant.
“Jin Runcandel, Sword Emperor Ron Hairan will never forget your efforts and courage in this matter.”
But there was one thing Jin didn't expect.
Ron's words were not only filled with cunning politics but also sincere appreciation. Ron genuinely rated Jin's role in this incident very highly.
Jin responded by quietly bowing his head.

“Furthermore, Hairan will express deep gratitude and… condolences for the dedication of those who fought together in the terror. Too many people have been sacrificed to terror. We promise to take responsibility in some form.”
As Ron bowed his head, the other warriors had no choice but to bow even lower.
When they raised their heads, their gazes naturally gathered on Jin.
It was burdensome to keep looking at Ron, and it was natural for the 12th rider of Runcandel, who recently shook the Sword Garden and stood out in the Sword Emperor's Castle, to be intriguing.
Jin found the eyes of Lata Proch, who stood out among them, to be overwhelming, so he looked away and stared at Zephilin, who was being scolded by Murakan in the corner.
‘The Demon Dragon.’
Of course, there was no confirmation yet that Zephilin was the Demon Dragon, but Jin thought he would have to meet the Black King as soon as the situation calmed down.
For the time being, everyone here would not be able to leave Hairan for the investigation of the truth.
It had been about two weeks since the "Sword Emperor's Castle Terror" incident on November 10, 1799.
Not only Hairan, but the whole Vermont Continent was still unable to shake off the shock from that day. The same was true for people from other lands who had only heard the news through print.
The Sword Emperor's Castle still remained in its ruined state.

Restoration had not yet begun. Most of the family members were living in tents near the castle, and as a result, only the Sword Emperor's Castle in the Vermont homeland appeared to be in a state of war.
In fact, the Sword Emperor's Castle was at war.
They were fighting against those they had believed to be allies. The Vermont Royal Family did not help Hairan.

Not only did they not help, but they were strangely critical of Kinzelo. Even though the perpetrators of the terror and the damage they caused to Hairan were clear, the royal pens still did not call Kinzelo a terrorist.

They only used ambiguous expressions like "an unfortunate accident." The royal family even claimed that they could not be sure that the giant magical creatures and biological golems used in the terror were Kinzelo's.
Not many people had anticipated that the royal family would take such a lukewarm approach. However, those who saw their current attitude could all deduce the same thing.
There had been some kind of deal between the royal family, Kinzelo, and Zipfel after the incident.
Not only Kinzelo but also Zipfel claimed that they had nothing to do with the terror after taking Veradin, and the royal family was tacitly accepting it.
Initially, since Kinzelo was suspected of targeting Veradin, Zipfel should have paid Hairan for it.
Taming or killing. That was how the royal family dealt with Hairan.
In a way, Hairan had been betrayed by the royal family.
"Phew…"
In the basement of the Sword Emperor's Castle, Dante sighed with a tired face. The underground spaces of the castle were generally intact compared to the ground.
Jin put a hand on Dante's shoulder.
"Are you worried about meeting him, Dante?"
"If not, it would be a lie."
"Let's hope his diary remains an impenetrable area."
Thump, thump, thump.
Footsteps were heard from the darkness. Soon, a person wearing a robe and the knights leading him appeared.
It was Veradin.
As Dante gestured, the knights stepped back, and Veradin removed his hood to reveal his face. The shadows of the three people were swaying heavily in the empty basement.
Dante did not offer his unique, cheerful, and polite greeting as if he had met a truly dear person, and Veradin also kept his mouth tightly shut.
After a heavy silence for a while, it was Veradin who first broke the silence.
